Definition: to pluck up (especially by the roots); specifically, to hamstring; figuratively, to exterminate
BiblicalUsage: 1) to pluck up, root up; 1a) (Qal) to pluck up, root up; 1b) (Niphal) to be plucked up; 2) to cut, hamstring; 2a) (Piel) to cut, hamstring
